memories.author: D04
memories.text: Allergic rhinitis: perennial sensitisation to dust mites and pollen. Symptoms: sneezing, watery nasal discharge, nasal congestion worse in mornings. Reaction: type I hypersensitivity, controlled with antihistamine and intranasal steroid.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis
  Status: Moderate, persistent symptoms despite occasional cetirizine.
  Plan: Start cetirizine 10 mg HS, fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD, montelukast 10 mg HS. Review in 4 weeks.
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  Status: NAFLD suspected, BMI 28, waist 92 cm (male cut‑off 90 cm).
  Plan: Silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD. Lifestyle: weight reduction 5% target, Mediterranean diet. Due: HbA1c in 3 months (2025-07-05).
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  Status: IBS‑M, bloating, alternating diarrhoea/constipation.
  Plan: Mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS. Advise small frequent meals, avoid trigger foods.
Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm. Diet advice: Breakfast – whole grain toast + egg; Lunch – lentil soup + salad; Dinner – grilled fish + steamed vegetables.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:

memories.text:

Total serum IgE: 210 IU/mL (ref <100).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
HbA1c 5.8% (ref 4-5.6) borderline ↑
CBC: WBC 6.2 ×10⁹/L, Hb 12.8 g/dL, platelets 210 ×10⁹/L
Stool routine: Ova/cyst nil, pus cells 0-2/hpf
tTG‑IgA: Negative (<4 U/mL).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis
  Status: Improved, occasional nocturnal congestion.
  Plan: Continue cetirizine HS, fluticasone OD, consider tapering montelukast if symptoms stay mild.
- NAFLD
  Status: ALT 34 U/L (now normal), waist 89 cm (just below male cut‑off).
  Plan: Continue silymarin TDS, rosuvastatin OD. Repeat LFT and lipid in 3 months.
- IBS
  Status: Symptoms controlled, occasional bloating.
  Plan: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD, loperamide SOS as needed.
Weight 76 kg, waist 89 cm. Diet advice: Breakfast – oats + milk; Lunch – chapati + dal + veg; Dinner – paneer stir‑fried + salad.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-10-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis
  Status: Well controlled, no exacerbations.
  Plan: Continue current regimen; consider stopping montelukast after 3 months if asymptomatic.
- NAFLD
  Status: ALT 31 U/L, waist 88 cm. Lipid: Cholesterol 195 mg/dL, TG 140 mg/dL.
  Plan: Continue silymarin, rosuvastatin. Repeat lipid and LFT in 6 months.
- IBS
  Status: Symptom‑free on current regimen.
  Plan: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD; keep loperamide SOS.
Weight 75 kg, waist 88 cm. Diet advice: Breakfast – idli + sambar; Lunch – brown rice + curd + veg; Dinner – grilled chicken + quinoa.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2026-01-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis
  Status: Minimal symptoms, uses cetirizine PRN.
  Plan: Stop montelukast, continue cetirizine HS and fluticasone OD as needed.
- NAFLD
  Status: Stable, ALT 29 U/L, waist 86 cm (<90). Lipid: Cholesterol 185 mg/dL, TG 120 mg/dL.
  Plan: Continue silymarin TDS, consider tapering rosuvastatin if LDL <100 after re‑check.
- IBS
  Status: Asymptomatic.
  Plan: Continue ispaghula husk OD, mebeverine BD PRN, loperamide SOS.
Weight 73 kg, waist 86 cm. Diet advice: Breakfast – poha + peanuts; Lunch – millet roti + dal + sabzi; Dinner – fish curry + brown rice.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2026-12-20 (annual).
